interactions.label: Familiar songs & community performances
interactions.description: Songs and stories chosen with participants; a bilingual host invites requests. Watch, clap or join in from a chair, wheelchair or standing position.

interactions.label: Language & conversation
interactions.description: Picture prompts, familiar sayings and conversation in preferred languages; Mandarin, Cantonese and English are example options. Listen, point to a picture or speak at your own pace.

interactions.label: Everyday device skills
interactions.description: Practice video calls, photos and larger text using step-by-step visual prompts. One-to-one help, a supported tablet and repeatable small steps.

interactions.label: Everyday movement
interactions.description: A staff-led group with familiar music and easy-to-follow demonstrations. Standing, chair-based or wheelchair upper-body movement; rest whenever needed.

interactions.label: Music & dance
interactions.description: Participant-selected music, familiar rhythms and a simple shared sequence. Standing steps or seated rhythm and arm movements.

interactions.label: Tai chi together
interactions.description: Slow, flowing gestures with a visible leader and time to follow. A seated version mirrors the upper-body sequence; a care aide stays nearby.

interactions.label: Calligraphy & brushwork
interactions.description: Explore personally meaningful characters and brush strokes, with large sample cards. Thick-handled brushes, supported paper and hand-over-hand help when requested.

interactions.label: Seasonal arts & crafts
interactions.description: Paper, color and collage inspired by the group’s interests and celebrations. Choose, arrange or create with large pieces and individual assistance.

interactions.label: Rhythm & instruments
interactions.description: Simple percussion, listening and shared rhythms around favorite songs. Lightweight shakers and a supported hand drum; listening is welcome.

interactions.label: TCM & cultural wellness talks
interactions.description: A hosted educational conversation about traditional Chinese medicine, with bilingual discussion and questions. Seated listening, visual prompts and time for questions; a quiet table option stays available.

interactions.label: Quiet creative table · choose your pace
interactions.description: Calligraphy and arts remain available alongside group sessions; participants may choose a quieter activity.
